questions.question: Some persons can do a piece of work in 84 days. Two times the number of such persons will do half of the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
Let the number of persons be x

Since, x persons can do 1 work in 84 days

So, 1 person can do 1 work in 84 × x days = 84x days

⇒ 2x persons can do 1 work in 84x/ 2x = 42 days

∴ Persons can do ½ work in 42/2 = 21 days

questions.question: The product of two numbers is 6845, if the H.C.F of the number is 37, then find the greater number.
questions.solution:
Given, H.C.F = 37

So, the numbers are 37x and 37y

Since, L.C.M × H.C.F = product of two numbers

⇒ L.C.M × 37 = 6845

⇒ L.C.M = 185

⇒ 37xy = 185

⇒ xy = 5

So, x = 1, y = 5 or x = 5, y = 1

⇒ The greater number is 37 × 5

∴ Required Number = 185

questions.question: The ratio of selected to unselected candidates was 14 : 25. If 35 less had applied and 10 less selected, the ratio of selected to unselected would have been 3 : 5. What is the Number of candidates who had applied for a job?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of selected to unselected candidates was 14 : 25. If 35 less had applied and 10 less selected, the ratio of selected to unselected would have been 3 : 5

**Calculation:**

Let the number of selected candidates be 14x and the number of unselected candidates be 25x ber of candidates is 195 who had applied for a job.

So, the total number of applied candidates is 14x + 25x = 39x

According to question,

If 35 less applied, then resulting number of candidates applied is (39x - 35)

And 10 less candidates got selected, then the resulting no of candidates selected is (14x - 10).

So, the resulting no of unselected candidates is (applied - selected)

⇒ (39x - 35) - (14x - 10)

⇒ 25x - 25

Now, the given ratio of resulting selected to the resulting unselected candidates is 3 : 5

So, (14x - 10)/(25x - 25) = 3/5

⇒ x = 5

So, the number of candidates who had applied = 39x

⇒ 39 × 5

= 195

**∴ The Number of candidates is 195 who had applied for a job.**

questions.question: A can do 50% of the job in 16 days, B can do one-fourth of the same job in 24 days. Working together, In how many days they can do seven-fourth of the job?
questions.solution:
Since, 50% job is done by A in 16 days

So, 100% job is done by A in 32 days

Since, ¼ part of work in done by B in 24 days

⇒ 1 work is done by B in 96 days

⇒ The work done by (A + B) in one day = 1/32 + 1/96 = 1/24 part of work

⇒ The whole work is done by (A + B) in 24 days

∴ 7/4th part of work is done by (A + B) in 24 × 7/4 = 42 days

⇒ 21x/25 = 13440

questions.question: A motor car moves at a speed of 72 km/h and 54 km/h after and before repairing respectively. It covers X distance in 6 hours after repairing. How much time (in hours) will it take to cover 5X distance before repairing?
questions.solution:
Let T be the time taken by the car to cover 5X distance before repairing

Since, distance = speed × time

So, X = 72 × 6

⇒ X = 432 km

Now, according to question

5 × 432 = 54 × T

⇒ T = 40 hours

∴ Required time is 40 hours

questions.question: The ratio of the number of rural and urban workers (includes men and women only) in an office is 3 : 2. If 20% of rural and 25% of urban are women, then find the percentage of men.
questions.solution:
Let the number of rural workers and urban workers be 3x and 2x respectively

According to question,

The number of rural women = 3x × 20% = 3x/5

So, the number of rural men = 3x – 3x/5 = 12x/5

And, the number of urban women = 2x × 25% = x/2

⇒ The number of urban men = 2x – x/2 = 3x/2

⇒ The total number of men workers in the office = 12x/5 + 3x/2 = 39x/10

⇒ The required percentage = [(39x/10)/5x] × 100%

∴ The percentage of men workers in the office is 78%

questions.question: The length of the diagonal of rectangle is 26 cm and one side 10 cm. Find the area of the rectangle.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diagonal = 26

Side = 10

**Formula used:**

(diagonal)2 = l2 + b2

area = length × breath

**Calculation:**

Let the other side of the rectangle be l cm

⇒ (diagonal)² = l² + b²

⇒ 10² + l² = 262

⇒ 100 + l² = 676

⇒ l = 24 cm

The area of the rectangle is

⇒ 24 × 10

**∴ The area of the rectangle is 240 cm².**

questions.question: A sport car going at an average speed of 108 km/h takes 15 minutes to complete a lap on a racing track. How much speed (in km/h) should be increased to complete the lap in 9 minutes?
questions.solution:
Distance covered by the car in one lap = 108 × 15/60

⇒ 27 km

So, to complete a lap of 27 km the speed of car must be = 27/(9/60)

⇒ 180 km/hour

⇒ Increased speed should be 180 – 108

∴ Increased speed should be 72 km/hour

questions.question: On selling 36 mobiles, a mobile vendor got a loss equivalent to the selling price of four mobiles. Find the loss percent.
questions.solution:
Let the selling price of one mobile be Re. 1

So, the selling price of 36 mobiles is Rs. 36

And the selling price of 4 mobiles is Rs. 4

⇒ The loss of vendor = Rs. 4

⇒ The cost price of the vendor = 36 + 4 = Rs. 40

⇒ Loss% = (4 /40) × 100

∴ Loss% is 10%

questions.question: The ratio of the sum of the salaries of A and B to the difference of their salaries is 11 : 1. The ratio of the sum of the salaries of B and C to the difference of their salaries is also 11 : 1. If A’s salary is the highest and C’s is the lowest then what is B’s salary (in Rs.), given that the total of their salaries is Rs. 18,200?
questions.solution:
According to question,

frac{{A + B}}{{A - B}} = frac{{11}}{1} --- (i)

frac{{B + C}}{{B - C}} = frac{{11}}{1} --- (ii)

And,

A + B + C = 18200 --- (iii)

From (i), we get

A + B = 11A – 11B

⇒ 10A = 12B

⇒ A = 6B/5 --- (iv)

From (ii), we get

⇒ C = 5B/6 --- (v)

On putting the value of (iv) and (v) in equation (iii), we get

⇒ 6B/5 + B + 5B/6 = 18200

⇒ 91B/30 = 18200

⇒ B = 6000

Therefore, the salary of B is Rs. 6000

The cuboid is cut from the middle of each face to get 8 identical cuboids

questions.question: Aman’s annual income has increased by Rs. 20 lakhs but the tax on income that he has to pay has reduced from 20% to 16%. He now pays the same amount of tax as earlier. What is his new total income (in Rs. lakhs)?
questions.solution:
Let the annual income of Aman be Rs. x

New annual income = (x + 20)

According to question,

x × 20% = (x + 20) × 16%

⇒ x/5 = 16(x + 20)/100

⇒ 20x = 16x + 320

⇒ 4x = 320

⇒ x = 80

So, the new total income = Rs 20 + 80

∴ New salary becomes 100 lakhs.
